createOrdering.name: Request body read and CreateOptions decoded
createOrdering.detail: Body is read with the MaxRequestBodyBytes limit, CreateOptions are decoded from the query and validated. fieldValidation defaults to Warn when unset; only Warn/Strict select the strict decoder, and under Warn unknown or duplicate fields become warnings and are dropped from the object.

createOrdering.name: Decode, scheme defaulting, conversion to the internal version
createOrdering.detail: The decoder is DecoderToVersion(serializer, HubGroupVersion), a defaulting codec built on the scheme. Decode applies the registered defaulters (SetObjectDefaults_Pod/Service/ConfigMap) to the decoded v1 object before converting it to the internal type. Defaulting therefore runs before field management and before any admission plugin, and fields that admission later adds are not scheme-defaulted.

createOrdering.name: Name/namespace resolution
createOrdering.detail: The name is taken from the object if the URL has none. The context namespace comes from the URL.

createOrdering.name: System metadata wipe and namespace defaulting
createOrdering.detail: WipeObjectMetaSystemFields clears creationTimestamp, uid, deletionTimestamp, deletionGracePeriodSeconds and selfLink. It does not clear generation, resourceVersion or managedFields. EnsureObjectNamespaceMatchesRequestNamespace sets metadata.namespace to the request namespace when it is empty and rejects a mismatch.

createOrdering.name: Admission attributes built; ownerReferences deduplicated
createOrdering.detail: Attributes carry the (possibly empty, for generateName) name, operation Create and the CreateOptions. Duplicate ownerReferences (same UID and semantically equal) are removed before and again after mutating admission, with a warning.

createOrdering.name: Field manager computes metadata.managedFields
createOrdering.detail: FieldManager.UpdateNoErrors runs on the decoded, defaulted object against an empty live object before mutating admission. The manager is the fieldManager query option, else the User-Agent prefix, else 'unknown'. The operation is Update, the apiVersion is v1, fieldsType is FieldsV1 and time is time.Now().UTC(). A non-empty, decodable client-supplied managedFields list is kept and merged.

createOrdering.name: Mutating admission
createOrdering.detail: The chain calls Admit on every plugin that handles Create and implements MutationInterface, in AllOrderedPlugins order. A reinvocation wrapper may run the chain a second time if a plugin requests it. A wrapper restores the pre-admission managedFields if admission leaves them invalid.

createOrdering.name: Store.Create entry; generateName retry
createOrdering.detail: requestFunc calls the registry's Create with createValidation = AdmissionToValidateObjectFunc(admit). If generateName is set without a name, create is retried up to 8 times with fresh random names on AlreadyExists.

createOrdering.name: FillObjectMetaSystemFields and name generation
createOrdering.detail: creationTimestamp = metav1.Now() and uid = new random UUID. The name is generated from generateName as base + 5 random characters. Both happen before validating admission.

createOrdering.name: BeginCreate hook (Service only among the three kinds)
createOrdering.detail: Service: normalizeClusterIPs, then allocateCreate runs initIPFamilyFields (ipFamilyPolicy, ipFamilies), ClusterIP allocation and NodePort allocation (NodePort/LoadBalancer only). Allocation happens before strategy validation and before validating admission. It is committed after a successful storage write and reverted otherwise. Pod and ConfigMap stores set no BeginCreate.

createOrdering.name: rest.BeforeCreate: PrepareForCreate, strategy Validate, WarningsOnCreate, Canonicalize
createOrdering.detail: Checks that system metadata is filled and the name generated, ensures the namespace, calls strategy.PrepareForCreate (Pod: generation=1, status reset to phase Pending, DropDisabledPodFields, scheduling-gated condition, matchLabelKeys merge, AppArmor sync, pod-level resource defaulting, qosClass; Service: status reset; ConfigMap: no-op), then strategy.Validate plus ObjectMeta validation and declarative validation, then warnings and Canonicalize (a no-op for all three kinds).

createOrdering.name: createValidation: validating admission chain, including ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
createOrdering.detail: Called with obj.DeepCopyObject() after BeforeCreate, so the policy cannot mutate the persisted object. The final attributes take the generated name if the request had none. Validating plugins run in AllOrderedPlugins order. ValidatingAdmissionPolicy runs before ValidatingAdmissionWebhook and ResourceQuota.

createOrdering.name: Storage write
createOrdering.detail: etcd3 Create refuses a non-zero resourceVersion and clears resourceVersion and selfLink before encoding. It writes with OptimisticPut and decodes the result into 'out' at the etcd revision, which sets metadata.resourceVersion. resourceVersion is assigned only here, after validating admission.

createOrdering.name: Post-write hooks
createOrdering.detail: finishCreate(true) commits the Service IP/port transaction. AfterCreate and Decorator run on 'out' only (Service Decorator defaultOnRead fills ipFamilies/ipFamilyPolicy only when empty, for objects written before those fields existed).

createOrdering.name: Too-large retry
createOrdering.detail: If the write fails because the serialized object is too large, the handler sets managedFields to nil and calls requestFunc again. Store.create runs again, including FillObjectMetaSystemFields (new uid and timestamp), BeginCreate and createValidation, so the policy sees a second object without managedFields.

unverified: The exact fieldsV1 content of the server-created managedFields entry was not traced into structured-merge-diff. That the set is computed from the decoded and defaulted object against an empty live object, and so includes defaulted fields, is an inference from create.go:194-199 and structuredmerge.go:91-117.

CEL equality on schemaless list values (ordered or not) and int/double heterogeneous equality were not traced into cel-go. The Validation doc comment (types.go:347) describes set/map list semantics for typed lists, but the schemaless path may not apply it.

The admissionregistration v1 Validation doc comment (types.go:330-331) says only apiVersion, kind, metadata.name and metadata.generateName are accessible from the object root. The 1.37 evaluation path (condition.go:78 -> SchemalessTypedToVal) exposes the full JSON shape. typechecking.go was not read and nothing was run, so access to object.metadata.labels/annotations/managedFields is inferred from code, not observed.

Whether request.options.fieldValidation / fieldManager can be read in CEL was not traced. options is declared DynType (compile.go:87) and filled with RawExtension{Object: CreateOptions} (condition.go:154-156); the RawExtension rendering by SchemalessTypedToVal was not read.

The absence of any hashing or canonical-serialization function in the CEL environment is inferred from the library list in environment/base.go:57-189. The individual libraries (library.Format, library.Lists, ext.Strings, etc.) were not read.

Size ceilings for policy objects and manifests were not read: MaxRequestBodyBytes, the etcd request size, and file-size limits in manifest/loader.go LoadFiles (read only for hashing). Embedding large expected objects in a policy is therefore unbounded only as far as this research knows.

That a client-supplied metadata.generation survives on Service/ConfigMap CREATE is a static reading: no SetGeneration in the create path read, and objectmeta.go:290 checks only non-negativity. Not executed.

The ValidatingAdmissionPolicy status controller (typeChecking, observedGeneration) and its relation to the admission plugin's in-memory hooks were not read. No API signal was found that proves an API-registered policy is active in the plugin.

Static manifest reload: only the polling interval, the hash short-circuit and the metrics were read. Atomicity of a reload with respect to in-flight requests, and behaviour on a partially written directory, were not traced.

The W02g allowlist assumes MutatingAdmissionPolicy and the mutating webhook are disabled. If either were on, it would run before ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (plugins.go:110-112) and could mutate any field. This research covers only the in-tree plugins listed.

Cluster-specific values (service CIDR families, default toleration flags, the presence of LimitRange/PriorityClass/RuntimeClass objects, Node topology labels) depend on the W03 distribution and sealed configuration and were not observed.
Nothing was executed against a running apiserver. All presentAtVAP values come from static reading of the create path at the pinned commit.
